title: Step 3 - Understanding Linear SVM Limitations: Why It Didn't Beat kNN Classifier

cues.en: Instructor: And now we're actually going to understand why.
cues.zh: 現在我們要理解原因。

cues.en: Why didn't the SVM model beat the kNN?
cues.zh: 為什麼 SVM 模型沒有超越 KNN？

cues.en: Okay, so we'll actually figure that out in a bit.
cues.zh: 我們很快就會知道。

cues.en: Or actually, you know, I can just show it to you here on the original implementation of the SVM but you're gonna understand now why it didn't beat it.
cues.zh: 其實我可以直接在原始 SVM 實作中展示，你現在就會明白為何沒有超越。

cues.en: Well, there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: It didn't beat it because once again since we chose a linear kernel, well the prediction boundary or you know, the decision boundary is actually once again a straight line.
cues.zh: 因為我們選擇線性核心，所以預測邊界，也就是決策邊界，再次是一條直線。

cues.en: And therefore even if you rotate it either this way or this way well it won't be able to catch the right prediction for you know, these green customers here
cues.zh: 因此無論往這個方向或那個方向旋轉，都無法正確預測這裡的綠色顧客，

cues.en: which should belong to the green regions.
cues.zh: 他們應該屬於綠色區域。

cues.en: And same for this one.
cues.zh: 這個也是。

cues.en: You know, if we rotate it this way well we will catch these ones, but then we will catch more incorrect predictions around here.
cues.zh: 如果這樣旋轉，就能涵蓋這些點，但同時這附近會有更多錯誤預測。

cues.en: And if we rotate this way, you know, from here to here well indeed we will catch these ones in the right prediction region, but we will get more incorrect ones here.
cues.zh: 如果往另一邊轉，從這裡轉到這裡，雖然能把這些點放進正確預測區域，卻會讓這裡出現更多錯誤。

cues.en: So that's the problem of linear models here.
cues.zh: 這就是線性模型在這裡的問題。

cues.en: Indeed, it's much better to have a prediction boundary that does some kind of a curve here in order to catch only the red customers who should be predicted not to buy the SUV
cues.zh: 如果預測邊界能在這裡形成某種曲線，只涵蓋應該預測不購買 SUV 的紅色顧客，

cues.en: and leave the green ones in the green region.
cues.zh: 並讓綠色顧客留在綠色區域，會好得多。

cues.en: Alright?
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: That's exactly what we got with our K nearest neighbors, right?
cues.zh: 這正是 K 最近鄰做到的，對吧？

cues.en: It is not a smooth curve, but it did the job of selecting the right red customers here.
cues.zh: 它不是平滑曲線，但確實在這裡選出了正確的紅色顧客。

cues.en: Still leaving some green ones but here catching the right green ones in the right region, the green region.
cues.zh: 雖然仍留下部分綠色點，但這裡的綠色點有落在正確的綠色區域。

cues.en: And here of course, since we have the straight line it's impossible to do, but no worries.
cues.zh: 當然，這裡因為是直線，所以做不到。不過別擔心。

cues.en: I'm sure you have the intuition that once we use a non-linear kernel, well, we'll be able to catch the right green observations here in the right green region.
cues.zh: 相信你已經直覺想到，只要使用非線性核心，就能把這裡的綠色觀測值放進正確的綠色區域。

cues.en: And well, that's exactly what we'll find out in the next section when implementing the kernel SVM model.
cues.zh: 下一節實作核心 SVM 模型時，就會看到。

cues.en: All right, so let's see if we're done here.
cues.zh: 好，看看這裡完成了沒。

cues.en: Yes, we are.
cues.zh: 是的，完成了。

cues.en: So it finished to execute and of course we get the same results.
cues.zh: 已執行完畢，當然得到相同結果。

cues.en: And let's see for the test set.
cues.zh: 再看看測試集。

cues.en: Still running, but N.
cues.zh: 還在執行，不過，

cues.en: Oh wow.
cues.zh: 哇。

cues.en: Okay, so funny timing, it just populated here and well you know, still the same because of this straight line here.
cues.zh: 時間真巧，剛好顯示出來。因為這裡的直線，結果仍然一樣。

cues.en: Well, we have some green customers, you know customers who bought in reality the new SUV but couldn't be predicted correctly because they fall in the wrong region because of this prediction boundary
cues.zh: 有些綠色顧客實際上購買了新 SUV，卻無法正確預測，因為預測邊界不能妥善分開

cues.en: that cannot separate well are two classes.
cues.zh: 兩個類別，導致他們落在錯誤區域。

cues.en: Alright, so same problem.
cues.zh: 好，所以是同一個問題。

cues.en: And you know, you might guess that this problem will be fixed once we choose a non-linear kernel for our support vector mission model.
cues.zh: 你應該猜得到，替支援向量機模型選擇非線性核心後，這個問題就能解決。

cues.en: Alright, so let's find out about this in the next section on kernel SVM, and until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 下一節核心 SVM 一起來看看。在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
